layers.message: Record scope, design, and development plan for low-stock alerts
Add low-stock evaluation to inventory report
Add low-stock tests and record Increment 1 verification
Include items at the reorder threshold in low-stock evaluation

problemsMatch: scoped Tester correction requires Assessment Purpose CORRECTION

graderOnly: Frame 2 is Tester's correction of a test defect Developer found while repairing the Frame 1 implementation defect; Frame 1 holds Tester's suspended INCREMENT / Increment 1 assignment (Suspended Assignment 1 in the verification report's Resume or Handoff section). Developer's own suspended CORRECTION assignment for Frame 2 is in the plan's Plan Notes.

packages/core/src/lowStock.js already uses quantity <= reorderPoint(item) (the Frame 1 repair is applied and committed); DEV-001 is IN_PROGRESS only because Developer could not confirm it while a Tester-owned test fails.

The only failing test is 'uses the default threshold when none is set' in packages/core/test/low-stock.test.js: it expects ['B1'], but B2 has 5 units and no threshold, so by AC-001 and AC-002 (default 5, at or below) the correct expectation is ['B1', 'B2']. Correcting that expectation makes pnpm --filter @stockroom/core test pass all 7 tests; pnpm --filter @stockroom/cli test already passes.
DEV-003 (CLI --low-stock, AC-003, Increment 2) is unimplemented by design; it is future approved work, not a defect.
The pending AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION cadence request in STATE.md is applied by Developer only once recovery returns to normal development; Tester leaves it pending.
